description: The signed-in couple's own seating charts on Zola: for each event, the tables, the guest on each seat, the free seats, and the guests with no seat. Each guest has the guest_id of zola_search_my_guests. Filter by the event_id of zola_list_my_wedding_events. Does not change the chart. No email, phone or address. Requires Zola sign-in (account:read).

event_id.description: Event ID from zola_list_my_wedding_events: only the chart of that event. Leave it out for every event.

name: zola_get_my_seating_chart

outputSchema.description: The seating charts of the signed-in couple

charts.description: The default chart of each event

event_start_local.description: The local start of the event, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS

seated_count.description: The seats with a guest or a partner of the couple

seats.description: The seats with somebody on them

guest_id.description: The guest_id of zola_search_my_guests. Null for the couple

unseated_count.description: The guests of the chart with no seat

unseated_truncated.description: True when Zola gave only a part of the guests with no seat

exists.description: False when the couple has no seating chart

title: Get My Seating Chart
